versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the alibabacloud-oss-direct-access-link-diagnosis skill.
- Diagnoses common OSS direct-access link issues: forced downloads, preview failures, 403 errors (EC 0003-00000005), custom domain binding failures, and referer whitelist/blacklist false positives.
- Enforces strict read-only operation: never writes or generates mutating commands, only outputs configuration templates and guidance.
- Diagnostic logic is entirely driven by supplied scripts; prohibits direct API/SDK calls or credential handling.
- Clearly defines scope boundaries, rerouting out-of-scope requests to sibling skills.
